versions.changelog:
- Tightened input requirements: generation route now requires a confirmed topic, title, or script and explicitly forbids style-word-only requests.
- Added safety on key inputs: do not invent a topic or title if none is provided.
- Clarified default behavior: removed any suggestion to default to Xiaohongshu 3:4 aspect ratio.
- Improved guidance on in-image text: now specifies freezing short text and its placement when required, and checking text visibility.
- Documentation and workflow clarifications; removed redundant or outdated instructions and the unused skill-card.md file.
Publish the reviewed WeChat Channels Cover Maker workflow with its English ClawHub listing.
